issue.title: bob-ledger-tools Stats fetch service drops pending waiters, spawns bob stats on every cache hit, and revalidates hidden views every ~3 s
issue.description:
## Proposed fix

1. Replace the single `statsPendingFetch` slot with a per-key in-flight map and a FIFO of distinct pending keys, run one at a time. Every waiter settles with its own key's result, or with an explicit cancellation.
2. Make cache hits freshness-aware: spawn only when the entry is dirty (a change counter advanced since `fetchedAt`) or older than a bound.
3. Stamp a change generation when a fetch starts. If a change arrives mid-fetch, publish the result as possibly stale and schedule exactly one follow-up.
4. Gate revalidation on visibility: an `IntersectionObserver` reports the view in view, the document is visible, and the leaf is shown. Hidden views keep a dirty flag and refresh when shown.
5. Tests in `scripts/test-ledger-tools-stats-data.cjs`: A/B/C waiters all settle; a warm remount spawns nothing; a hidden view spawns nothing on a vault change.

Context: the consolidated research recommends exactly these fixes as phase 1 of the daily-note Day strip (§5.7). They are worth doing even if the strip is never built.

task_type_fields.impact:
- **Defect 1:** any Stats view waiting on the dropped key keeps its skeleton until something else repaints it. It becomes likely as soon as more than one Stats consumer requests different keys at once, such as page range switching, or the proposed daily-note Day strip with several daily notes open.
- **Defects 2 and 3:** an open `dash_stats` tab re-runs a full vault pass (about 190 ms on the MacBook, 0.4–0.6 s on a loaded apollo) every ~3 s of editing anywhere, all day, and flickers the page's opacity. This is battery and CPU cost with no visible benefit while the page is hidden.

All three are prerequisites for putting any Stats rendering on the daily note.
task_type_fields.repro:
Read at bob-plugins `1202c6a`, `plugins/bob-ledger-tools/src/236-plugin-stats-data.js`. cdx also reproduced defect 1 with the real built plugin API and a mocked `statsSpawnFetch` (research `202610/daily_note_day_strip/daily_note_day_strip__cdx.md` §6).

1. **Lost waiter** (`apiStatsFetch`, ~lines 655-678). Start a fetch for key A, so it is in flight. While A is in flight, request an uncached key B, then an uncached key C. B's request creates `statsPendingFetch = {opts:B, waiters:[resolveB]}`. C's request sees a different pending key and replaces `statsPendingFetch` with a fresh object, which drops `resolveB`. When A finishes, only C launches and resolves. **B's promise never settles.** Harness result: A and C spawned, C settled, B unsettled after both completed.
2. **Every cache hit spawns.** With no flight in progress, `launch(...)` runs even when `cached` is present. `fetchedAt` is written in `statsCacheSet` (~line 611) but never consulted, so every remount or repaint of a cached view starts a full `bob stats show -a` vault pass.
3. **Background views revalidate on any change.** `setupStatsBlock` (238:57-80) routes every `metadataCache` `changed` event, and every vault create, delete, or rename, into `scheduleStatsRevalidate` (236:765-802). That is a 3 s *throttle* (the first event arms the timer; later events are dropped, not debounced). When it fires, `revalidateStatsBlocks` dims every view in `statsBlockViews` (`.bob-stats-revalidating`, 0.55 opacity) and spawns `bob stats`. Views stay in the set while their leaf is open, including a background `dash_stats` tab.

Minimal check for 3: open `dash_stats` in a tab, switch to a daily note, and type. A `bob stats` child runs about every 3 s for as long as edits continue.

issue.creation_reason: Found while consolidating the daily-note Day strip research. The shared bob-ledger-tools Stats fetch service can leave a request unsettled forever, and it re-runs full vault passes for cached and hidden views. These bugs exist today independent of the proposed feature.

payload.description: Both concern the cost of bob stats runs; 6n speeds up each run, while this bug cuts redundant runs from the plugin

payload.entry: Landing bob-cli-bp verified all three defects are fixed at bob-plugins af1e691+: (1) per-key in-flight map + FIFO of distinct pending keys (cap 8, explicit cancellation) — test 'A in flight, B then C settle with own reports'; (2) cache hits spawn only when dirty (change generation or 10 min age) — tests 'warm remount ... spawns nothing', 'change bump makes the next hit spawn exactly once', 'change during a flight leaves the stored entry dirty'; (3) revalidateStatsBlocks gates on visibility with needsRevalidate flush — tests 'hidden views never spawn', 'background tabs never spawn until the tab is visible again'. Full bob-plugins npm test 3648/3648 green.

payload.close_reason: Fixed by epic bob-cli-bp phase bob-cli-bp.2 (fetch-service), bob-plugins commit 6ce2e17
